method: Assume every resident epoch resumes after complete displacement. Retain the first unique lines from that context previous epoch, capped by both a global 128/192-line budget and 2/3 lines per cache set. Count retained lines used anywhere in the next epoch; each avoids at most one measured 39-cycle cold-data increment. Context 0 is interference and is not evaluated as a resident.
limits: This is a forced-displacement upper bound, not a cache RTL or cycle-accurate replay result.
The source traces are warm; addresses and recurrence are retained, while every evaluated resume is hypothetically made cold.
A retained matching line is credited a full 39 cycles even if its real service would hit below L1 or overlap another miss.
First-use history is used; an optimal retention selector could do better.
